newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $113/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $113/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested on a live basis, USDA said. Buyer inquiry good. Seller interest fair. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 68.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 68.00-68.50.
Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights) Steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 higher.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 112.00- 113,00, instances 111.00 early. ( weighted average 112.27).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1225 lbs 112.00- 113.00, instances 111.00 early. ( weighted average 111.97).

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis 1.00-2.00 lower; dressed basis 3.00 lower. Weekly total includes 10,000 formulated and previously contracted cattle. Confirmed - 7,700 Last Week - 17.700 Last Year - 46,400 Wk To Date- 38,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 63,400 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 84,600
